caveats: The Nahwa enclave (United Arab Emirates) inside Wilayat Madha is left outside every unit. A 1.64 km² gap in the source between Sur, Al Kamil Wa Al Wafi and Wadi Bani Khalid is merged into Sur, along Al Kamil Wa Al Wafi's edge as the boundary. A 27 km² overlap in the source between Jaalan Bani Bu Ali and Jaalan Bani Bu Hasan is split by topology cleaning, not along an official line. The wilayat layer names the Ministry of Interior as data owner under the ONSDI data ownership policy, with NCSI as republisher; the Open Government Licence excludes third-party data, so the Ministry of Interior's reuse terms are unconfirmed.
dataset_source: National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI), Sultanate of Oman
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
methodology_other:
Dataset: Governorate and wilayat boundaries downloaded from the NCSI GeoStat ArcGIS Server on 2026-10-05, published by NCSI under the Open Government Licence, Sultanate of Oman, which requires attribution to NCSI as the source and disclosure of changes. OCHA modified the data: overlaps between wilayats removed and gaps filled to match NCSI's governorate boundaries, the outer edge fitted to the admin 0 reference boundary, governorates dissolved from wilayats, unit-type words removed from names and three spellings corrected.  
  
P-codes: Government codes (NCSI governorate and wilayat IDs, zero-padded), prefixed with the ISO2 code.
name: cod-ab-omn
notes:
Oman administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 11 Governorate  
- Admin 2: 63 Wilayat  
  
  
Note: Names have the unit type (Governorate, Wilayat, محافظة, ولاية) removed in English and Arabic. Al Jabal Al Akhdar (OM0509, English and Arabic) and Jaalan Bani Bu Hasan (OM0803, Arabic) are spelling-corrected from the source. P-codes follow NCSI's IDs and share no codes with v01.  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 09 November 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 09 November 2026: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 05 October 2026: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 08 January 2023: boundaries created by the source  
  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
